title: Colleen Doran
description: Says Colleen Doran: "STAR WARS was supposed to be my first assignment when I went to work for Marvel Comis back in 1986, but I missed my chance to draw Lumiya — the female Darth Vader. So, here she is now!" Doran was born July 24, 1963 and has been a professional artist for 15 years. She is a writer, penciller, inker, colorist, painter and publisher. Projects include SANDMAN, AMAZING SPIDER-MAN, X-FACTOR, EXCALIBUR, HELL-RAISER, and nearly 100 other titles. Doran is the regular artist for DC's VALOR, the creator of A DISTANT SOIL, and her work can be seen in recent issues of LEGIONNAIRES, SILVER SURFER, ECLIPSO, GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY, NESTROBBER and DEATH GALLERY.
